notes.title: Post Gamescom Update
notes.content:
First off, thank you for all the new wishlists and to everyone who’s stuck with us over the years. Your support keeps this project going. 💙

Announcement: we’re taking part in Steam Next Fest on October 13. We’re shipping a big update for the event, and we’re pouring a ton of time and care into the game. We hope you’ll love what’s coming.

Release date: we’re aiming to launch on January 14, 2025.

In the meantime, keep building those Community Levels! If you’d like to support us, please share the game with your friends, especially during Steam Next Fest. The more players we have, the more visibility we get.

Alright onto the patch notes for this build:


Major updates
New objective: “Cluby count” (major gameplay impact). Levels now require reaching the goal with a specific number of Clubys; the UI has been overhauled to clearly show target and progress.

New Campaign Menu: Fresh structure and navigation for campaign content.

Level Selection: Controller support. Controller-native navigation added; includes integrated filtering & sorting flows. WIP: Full controller support for the game.

Main Menu: Controller fixes. Consolidated improvements for selection, navigation, and hover behavior.

New materials. Metal, LED Stripes, and Gradient Floor (incl. updated gradient assets and material images).

In-game audio updates. Editor SFX additions and tuning; conversions and volume/mix adjustments; better audio transitions (e.g., Game Over fade).
UI changes (bundled)
Highlights & History categories (including improved History and activated buttons), general navigation cleanups, placeholder/background fixes, controller-specific UI tweaks (e.g., hide search/text), screenshot-mode polish, and localization touch-ups.
Bug fixes & stability
Level Selection robustness (e.g., switching categories, loading new levels, ensuring a selection when switching input, filter reset behavior).

Controller scrolling & highlighting (sort direction scrolling, scroll highlight, repeated navigation).

Tag & filter edge cases (first tag auto-select, tags after deselecting filter, mouse filter fixes).

Startup/visual glitches (initial black screen, background/placeholder image issues).

Loading & file/path quirks (cancellation during level loading, using “_” instead of “/”, empty local club failing to load).

Misc UI regressions (category shrinking on controller exit, button icons, Y-button in categories except Community).

Party continue cooldown; “essence” no longer attracts when not over ground.

notes.title: The Clubies - Local Coop Festival Update
notes.content:
Hello Clubies Fans,

We're excited to announce a brand-new demo update for The Clubies! From February 10, 2025, to February 17, 2025, join us at the local multiplayer festival by trying out this special demo on Steam.

This update brings back our classic Coop Campaign and introduces an early test version of Community Levels along with our long-awaited Level Editor. Over the past months, we've been hard at work refining every detail—enhancing the sound design, squashing numerous minor bugs, and completely overhauling the UI to deliver an even smoother gaming experience.

Get ready to dive in, explore the new features, and share your feedback. Your input is crucial as we continue to shape the future of The Clubies.

Happy gaming,
The Clubies Team

notes.title: The Clubies: Demo Update v.0.4
notes.content:
Hey Clubies 🎉
We’re excited to bring you a brand new update! This update is packed with exciting new features, improvements, and technical upgrades. Check it out and let us know what you think!

Menu:

 New Main Menu: We’ve completely revamped the main menu to make it more visually appealing. It already contains buttons that we bring to life in the next update ;)


Gameplay Mechanics:

 Respawn Mechanic: When a Cluby dies, it now transforms into a Cluby Essence. Collect it to respawn the Cluby and continue the fun!
 Improved Beds: Beds have been optimized to function even more smoothly, enhancing overall gameplay flow.


Co-op Improvements:

 Independent Game Logic: Each player now operates with independent game logic, meaning e.g. one Cluby per player is always awake and can’t fall asleep or a player can jump out if tge cannon even if other players run around.
 Respawn Teammates: You can now respawn Clubies from other players, encouraging more teamwork in co-op play.


AI Improvements:

 AI as a Full Player: The AI now functions as a full-fledged player! It will be tracked by the camera, can win the game for you, set highscores, and even respawn your Clubies.
 AI Interaction: The AI can now interact with all in-game objects, such as cannons and beds.


Technical Improvements:

 Automatic User Management: From now on, you’ll be automatically logged in via your Steam account for highscores and other online features.
 Enhanced NPC AI: The AI has been technically upgraded to behave smarter, with more knowledge of the game world. This also allows us to create new AIs faster in future updates.

notes.title: The Clubies: Demo Update v.0.3
notes.content:
Hey Clubies 🎉

We released a new update for our free demo version of the game! This update is packed with exciting new features, visual improvements, and features for Gamescom. Let’s dive into the details:

Major Changes & New Features:

 Gamescom Features: This version includes all the changes prepared for Gamescom, plus more of the familiar levels. The highlight is a complete UI overhaul, with a fresh look and new localization.
 New UI Flow: We’ve developed a new flow for the demo, making future updates easier to integrate, such as account management and level selection. The UI now also features enhanced visualization for speedrunning, helping you track your Cluby's times more effectively.
 Co-op Mode: You can now team up with a friend in Co-op Mode! Seamlessly switch between single-player and co-op mode by pressing the Escape button and selecting "Enter Co-op Mode." 
 Cluby Essence Attraction: The Cluby Essence is now automatically attracted to your Clubies, making it easier to collect. More enhancements to the Cluby Essence are coming soon!


Visual & Gameplay Improvements:

 Enhanced Visuals for Co-op: We’ve refined the visuals specifically for Co-op Mode to ensure a smoother and more visually engaging experience.
 Level Adaptations: We’ve made minor tweaks to various levels to ensure a smoother and more enjoyable experience.


Quality of Life (QoL) Updates:

 Seamless Device Switching: Switch between devices without any interruptions, making your gameplay experience smoother than ever.
 New Language Localizations: Play the game in multiple languages, including Chinese, Japanese, and Saarländisch, broadening the accessibility of our game.


Technical Improvements:

 Bug Fixes: We’ve squashed several bugs to improve overall game stability and performance.
 AI Tweaks: Minor adjustments have been made to the AI, with more enhancements planned for future patches.


That’s all for now, Clubies! We hope you enjoy these new features and improvements. As always, keep the feedback coming, and stay tuned for even more exciting updates in the future! Happy gaming! 🎮✨

notes.title: The Clubies: Demo Update v.0.2
notes.content:
Hey Clubies 🎉
We released a new update for our free demo version of the game. This includes many visual improvements, an overall smoother gameplay experience, new useful features like choosing your own username and improved technical stability.

Visual Changes:

 Enhanced Spotlight Animations: Spotlight animations now highlight important gameplay elements, connecting the visual theme with gameplay!
 Refined Pressure Plate and Dancefloor: Adjustments have been made to the pressure plate and dancefloor for better integration into the game.
 Enchanting Backgrounds: Enhanced clouds and particle effects in the background.
 Wall Backface Material: If the camera moves inside a wall, you'll now see the wall's backface material.


Gameplay & Physics:

 Smoother Movement: Dancefloors and pressure plates no longer block your movement.
 Unlocked Doors: Doors can no longer be obstructed by objects, reducing exploit potential.
 Infinite Party Time: The new default dancefloor gives you unlimited time to party!
 Level Adjustments: Various tweaks to levels to enhance gameplay.
 Safer Electricity: Electricity can no longer jump to other objects.
 Powerful Lasers: Laser projectiles now have knockback, adding a new dynamic to some levels.


Quality of Life (QoL) Updates:

 Quick Restart: Restart after a game over by pressing the Jump button.
 Custom Usernames: You can now select your username.
 Easy Exit: Use the Escape button to exit the game.
 Level Tweaks: Minor adjustments to levels for a smoother experience.
 

Technical Improvements:

 Offline Highscores: See the latest highscores known to you even when playing offline. Your offline-created highscores will be submitted automatically when you have an internet connection again.
 Highscore Server Improvements: General improvements to our highscore server for better security and stability.
 Bug Fixes: Various bug fixes to improve game stability and performance.
